Our Founding Story

BUILT ON A FOUNDATION OF MILITARY DISCIPLINE

Elite Property Maintenance LLC was founded with a singular purpose: to deliver the kind of reliable, thorough, and high-caliber outdoor property care that property owners too often struggle to find.

After serving in the armed forces, our founder brought the core tenets of military service—punctuality, uncompromising standards, integrity, and respect—straight into the property maintenance industry. When we promise to be at your property on Tuesday morning, we are there. When we mow your lawn or plow your driveway, we don't consider the job complete until every edge is razor sharp and every walkway is spotless.

Whether we are managing an expansive commercial parking lot during a Michigan blizzard or providing weekly mowing for residential neighborhoods, we treat your property with the same care and respect as our own.

Our Core Values

WHAT SETS ELITE PROPERTY MAINTENANCE APART

Every service we perform is guided by four immutable principles.

Military Precision

We apply disciplined attention to detail. Sharp mowing lines, flush trimming against fences, and tidy cleanups with zero grass clippings left on driveways or flowerbeds.

Rock-Solid Reliability

When Michigan weather strikes or mowing season heats up, you need a contractor who shows up consistently. Our schedule is our word, and our word is our bond.

Honest, Fair Pricing

No hidden fees, no bait-and-switch estimates. We provide upfront quotes with competitive local rates, plus an automatic 20% discount for veterans and seniors.

Comprehensive Capability

From summer lawn care and fall cleanups to winter snow plowing, car hauling, and storm damage remediation, we are your single-call solution year-round.

Giving Back to Our Community

20% VETERANS & SENIORS DISCOUNT

We are deeply committed to honoring those who have served in our nation's military and supporting the senior citizens of our Central Michigan community.

Property maintenance can become demanding and dangerous as we age, especially during freezing Michigan winters or scorching summer days. That's why we extend a flat 20% discount on all regular lawn care and snow plowing services to qualifying veterans and seniors aged 62+.
